summary: Preserved candidate PR 2203 and corrected its reproduced Aibrix counterexample by including the logical KV cache dtype in every BlockHashes input.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate commit, fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2 produced identical Aibrix BlockHashes inputs.
After correction, fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2 produced distinct dtype-scoped Aibrix BlockHashes inputs.
62 focused tests passed, covering Aibrix logical FP8 isolation, legacy None behavior, and the candidate's file, hf3fs, Mooncake, UMBP, and config propagation regressions.

gpu_execution_evidence: Key derivation is CPU-only; no GPU execution was required or claimed.
remaining_limitations: Aibrix was unavailable, so its client boundary was validated with a stub rather than an end-to-end service.
FlexKV and LMCache packages/services were unavailable and their external key derivation remains unverified.
NPU memcache and SiMM require unavailable architectures/services; their dtype isolation remains unverified and was not changed speculatively.
No model weights, serving process, or multi-node workload was used.
